name: garmin_activities
description: List workouts in a date range, newest first: type, duration, distance, pace or speed, heart rate, time in HR zones, training load, training effect, VO2max, Body Battery impact, sets/reps. Default last 30 days, up to 100 items.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.

arguments.name: activity_type
arguments.desc: Garmin parent type key, e.g. running, cycling, swimming, fitness_equipment, walking, hiking.

arguments.name: search
arguments.desc: Text to match in activity names.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum activities to return, 1-100. Default 20.

name: garmin_activity
description: Full summary of one workout by activity_id (from garmin_activities): all measurements Garmin computed, including temperature, cadence, power, training effect messages.

arguments.name: activity_id
arguments.desc: Activity ID from garmin_activities.

name: garmin_api_get
description: Raw JSON from a Garmin Personal API endpoint not covered by other tools (SpO2 detail, stress/steps series, hydration, nutrition, menstrual cycle, fitness age history, HRV readings). Responses are large and truncated at 100 KB: prefer the dedicated tools.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.desc: Endpoint name (see enum).

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD for endpoints with {date}.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD for endpoints with {start}.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD for endpoints with {end}.

arguments.name: activity_id
arguments.desc: Activity ID for endpoints with {id}.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query parameters, e.g. {"calendarDate":"2026-11-11"}. Only keys documented for the endpoint are accepted.

name: garmin_body_battery
description: Per-day Body Battery (Garmin's 0-100 energy estimate): charged, drained, min/max, events that changed it (sleep, activities, naps) and Garmin's feedback. Optional intraday timeline. Range up to 31 days, default last 3.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.

arguments.name: include_timeline
arguments.desc: Include the intraday level series (adds roughly 1-3 KB per day).

name: garmin_daily_summary
description: Per-day wellness totals: steps, distance, calories, resting/min/max heart rate, intensity minutes, stress, Body Battery range, respiration, SpO2. Range up to 366 days, default last 7.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.

name: garmin_heart_rate
description: Intraday heart rate for one day, aggregated into local-time intervals (avg/min/max bpm per interval), plus resting, min, max and 7-day resting average.

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: Day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: interval_minutes
arguments.desc: Aggregation interval in minutes: 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 60, 120, 180 or 240. Default 60.

name: garmin_hrv
description: Per-night heart rate variability (HRV, ms): last-night average, 5-minute high, 7-day average, personal baseline band and Garmin's status (BALANCED, UNBALANCED, LOW, POOR). Range up to 366 days, default last 14.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.

name: garmin_profile
description: User context for interpreting other data: time zone and units, heart rate zones per sport, Fitness Age with its components, latest weight.

name: garmin_recovery_status
description: Readiness snapshot for one day (default today): last night's sleep; HRV, resting HR, sleep HR, breathing rate and yesterday's stress each compared with the user's own previous 28 days (mean, SD, z-score, days of history); Body Battery recharge; training load of the last 7 vs 28 days; plain-language signals with the method used. Use this first for 'how recovered am I' questions.

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: Day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

name: garmin_sleep
description: Per-night sleep: bedtime, wake time, duration, deep/light/REM/awake minutes, sleep score with sub-scores, average heart rate, sleep stress, SpO2, respiration, sleep need and Garmin's feedback. Filed under the wake-up date. Range up to 366 days, default last 7.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.

name: garmin_sleep_analysis
description: Sleep quality analysis over a period (default 28 days, up to 366): average duration vs Garmin's baseline sleep need and weekly shortfall, regularity (median sleep onset and wake time, spread, weekday-weekend shift), stage shares, sub-score counts, score trend, sleep heart rate, HRV, resting HR, SpO2, respiration, and factors from the previous day (stress above usual, late or hard workouts, low activity, late sleep onset) compared with sleep score, HRV and sleep HR. Use this first for sleep questions and recommendations.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.

name: garmin_trends
description: Weekly or monthly averages over a long period (default 12 weeks, up to 2 years): resting HR, HRV, sleep duration and score, steps, stress, Body Battery peak, intensity minutes, workout count, workout time, training load, weight. Small output; use it for progress and long-term patterns.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Length of the period ending today, 14-731 days. Default 84 (12 weeks).

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: period
arguments.desc: Bucket size: week (Monday-based) or month. Default week.

name: garmin_weight
description: Daily weigh-ins: weight (kg), BMI, body fat, muscle mass, body water where available. Range up to 2 years, default last 90 days.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local calendar. Default: computed from end_date and days.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days ending at end_date, used when start_date is omitted.
